'''Bille Doshun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He was inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were chasing [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Doshun wore an outfit of dark colors like black, maroon, and dark green, as well as black boots. His [[Hair/Legends|hair]] hung in two braids.
